title: Shop reputation
changes: Your shop now has a star rating. Keep shelves stocked, queues short, PCs up to date and repairs on time to climb towards 5★.
A better rating brings up to 15% more shoppers (and a bad one costs you up to 15%).
The new Reputation panel on the Shop tab shows what is costing you stars, and the Advisor tells you how to fix it.

title: Service Desk
changes: Open a Service Desk (Upgrades → Service) and fix customers' computers: virus removal, dial-up setup, Y2K checks, cracked screens, AI PC setup and more as the years go by.
Hire repair technicians, diagnostic benches, a remote support line and AI triage to keep up with walk-ins.
PC buyers can add an extended warranty: easy money, though some claims come back later.
A Service Desk panel on the Shop tab, two new trophies and new statistics.

title: Seasons and a bigger Hustle
changes: Every year now has a retail rhythm: the January lull, a Summer Game Sale, Back to School, Black Friday and the Holiday Rush.
Your buyers and the Advisor see the seasons coming, so stock up before the rush.
Hustle keeps up with your shop: busy shops land business orders worth seconds of income.
Hustle again right after the cooldown to build a 🔥 streak that improves your odds and order size.

title: The Near Future
changes: The calendar no longer stops at today: carry on to 2035 through two new eras, Spatial Shift and Quantum Curious.
Future tech to sell: smart-glasses-ready PCs, quantum hybrids, holo-desks, Wi-Fi 8, haptic gloves and more.
A new console generation: Obelisk Spire, Nimbus Six, Orbitron Ring Visor and Hanami Hybrid 3, with launch-day queues.
New Holo look for the future eras, plus new events, headlines and two trophies.

title: Faster franchises
changes: New HQ upgrade Time Warp: the early decades go by faster in every new franchise.
New HQ upgrade Head Start: open new franchises in 1996, 2000 or 2005, with cash to match.
Franchise Tokens arrive sooner: the first one now comes at $100M in sales instead of $200M.
HQ upgrades bought before your new shop's first sale (Founder's Fund, Starter Kit, Head Start) now apply to it straight away.
The app now announces each new era and when your first Franchise Token is ready.

title: Game Center
changes: On iPhone, your trophies are now Game Center achievements too, with progress rings for the ones you are still working on.
Trophies in the Menu show how close you are, and a Game Center button opens your achievements.

title: A fresh coat of paint
changes: Every screen in the app now looks the part of its era: Windoze 95 windows, glossy Bliss bars, clean Flat cards and neon RGB.
Item cards show performance and demand meters, upgrades show level bars, and the shop header tracks the year.
Hustling pops the sale over the button, and taps give a little haptic click.

title: Fixes
changes: Leaving the game in a background browser tab now counts as one stretch away, so the welcome-back report shows the whole time and your night-shift upgrades apply.
Menu → Statistics now shows sales and items sold across all your franchises.

title: Password reset
changes: Add an email to your account (optional) and you can reset a forgotten password with an emailed link, on the website or in the app.

title: Customers on the street
changes: The storefront now shows customers walking past your shop, and a 💲 pops up when one buys. Switch it off in Menu → Look.

title: Era themes and news ticker in the app
changes: The app now changes look with the era: Windoze 95, Bliss, Flat and RGB. Pick one yourself in Menu → Look.
The news ticker is back, scrolling era headlines and current events across the top (switch it off in Menu → Look).

title: New names for games, consoles and hardware
changes: Every PC and console game, publisher, console family and computer or part maker now has its own original name, from Hellcrawl and Carjack City to the Hanami, Nimbus and Obelisk consoles.
Nothing in your shop changes: stock, upgrades, buyers and saves all carry over, and your buyers' never-buy-from lists move to the new brand names.

title: PC Designer & change log
changes: New hire in the Buyers tab: the PC Designer studies demand and designs custom-PC blueprints for you, prices them to the market and retires old ones.
Auto-designed blueprints are tagged in the Workshop; tap Take over to manage one yourself.
The game now shows its version number (Menu → About) and pops up what changed after each update.

title: Collapsible buyers
changes: Collapse any buyer panel to compare them easily. Your choice is remembered.

title: Console gaming
changes: Consoles, console games and accessories, with console generations and launch events.
Console Corner upgrade, a Consoles filter in the Stock tab and a Consoles buyer.

title: HQ buyer upgrades & Shop Advisor
changes: Nine permanent HQ upgrades improve your buyers.
The shop summary now has an Advisor box with upgrade suggestions and insights.

title: Purchasing managers & list filters
changes: Hire a buyer for each product category. They watch trends and manage stock, with plenty of settings.
Filters on the Stock and Upgrades lists (current vs old, by popularity and more).

title: Games & accessories
changes: Sell PC games and accessories alongside your computers.
Customers add them on to PC purchases.

title: Franchise Tokens & slower calendar
changes: Late in the game you earn Franchise Tokens. Reset to claim them and spend them on permanent HQ upgrades.
The calendar runs a little slower.

title: Grand opening
changes: Run a computer shop from 1993 to today: prebuilts, custom builds, upgrades and offline progress.
Accounts and cloud saves.
